name: Frosted Field
concept: Carve every surface out of one pale gradient using translucency instead of borders or fills.

type.families: Geometric sans, light to regular (Aeonik, General Sans, Outfit). Low weight contrast.
type.hierarchy: Title 22/28 regular · figure 34/38 light · body 14/21 regular · label 11/14 regular in `--muted`. Thin, wide-set type suits the soft ground.
type.usage: Keep weights light — bold type fights the translucency. Sentence case. Labels sit above values, not beside them.

tokens.texture: Every surface is carved out of the gradient rather than drawn on top of it: `background: rgba(255,255,255,.55); backdrop-filter: blur(24px);` with a 1px inner highlight `rgba(255,255,255,.6)` and no outer border. One blurred colour metaball (a 320px circle of `--accent` at 30% opacity, `filter: blur(80px)`) drifts behind the content to give the field variation. Shadows are wide and faint.
tokens.layout: Soft and generous. 8px scale, 24px padding, 20-24px radius on cards, 999px on every control. Because nothing has a border, rely on 20px+ gaps for separation. Charts render as translucent gradient-filled bars or dot matrices, never as hard strokes.

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as soft 3D render or gradient abstraction with frosted glass elements.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- pale periwinkle-to-ice gradient ground
- translucent frosted panels with visible blur of what sits behind them
- one muted violet #5D51C8 and one seafoam #69C6AE as the only hues
- soft omnidirectional lighting, no hard shadows
- rounded organic forms, generous corner radii

NEGATIVE SPACE: The upper half stays a clean uninterrupted gradient.

DO NOT INCLUDE: hard edges, high contrast, dark backgrounds, neon, sharp specular highlights, dense detail.
